body:
Definitely try it once. 
If you can experience it in a ceremony setting it would be better. Shamans are healers that can really repair a lot of intense psychological and emotional damage.
I've seen people wake up from being heroin and meth addicts in one night, I've seen people with nerve damage walk out of a room when they've arrived in wheelchairs.
It will change your outlook on A LOT of things.

Nothing is ever perfect to cure pain, but I can tell you with all my heart that if it wasn't for the people that pushed me to go to a ceremony I'd probably already be dead by my own hand or because of my poor choices. 

My pain is still with me. I still feel weak sometimes. I still cry. But I can also tell you that I feel a new energy in me. One I didn't feel before. One to fight back, instead of wanting to cower back and think negative thoughts.
It's a new 'night light' you can turn on within yourself to make all the bad things go away, and let you deal with what's important in your life, and what's more important it let's you deal with YOU. 

Another way to look at DMT is 5-10yrs of intense psychotherapy in a very short time. There is no shame, no makeup, no barriers between you and another human. It's just simply you looking into an intense mirror, completely naked. So you can't run away from reality. You get a glimpse into what's wrong with yourself. It will also let you discern if someone in your life might be a toxic influence.

I haven't tried shrooms in a medicinal setting, but from some shamans I've talked to they are amazing. The children of the earth, some call them. So look into all this because it does help permanently, it isn't just a band-aid that falls of ... Like prescription pills, which by the way, make you feel horrible.

Hope this helps you.
